title: Nejedly-2020a-multicenter-10.1038/s41597-020-0532-5
description: This dataset provides intracranial EEG (SEEG) clips from a multicenter collection, converted to BIDS from the segmented .mat archives released with Nejedly et al. 2020. It consists of independent 3 s single-channel clips sampled at 5000 Hz, annotated for graphoelements and artifactual signals. Per-clip events preserve the original label, anatomy, reviewer ID, seizure onset zone flag, and electrode type.
methods_description: Independent 3 s single-channel iEEG clips from one subject and one SEEG contact were concatenated into each BIDS run at 5000 Hz. Events mark clip boundaries. Patient-specific electrode coordinates were not released, so electrodes.tsv lists contact names, material, and manufacturer with x/y/z as n/a. Runs are not time-contiguous recordings across clip boundaries.
